responsibility: Implements the main source-text lexer entry points and string reader for rustc_parse, converting raw source bytes into AST tokens and token streams, normalizing identifiers, validating literals and edition-sensitive token forms, handling comment and unicode-related lints, and coordinating lower-level token-tree lexing and literal escape diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `parser/mod.rs`, this module is the front-end that turns source text into tokens and token trees, including literal validation and lexing-time lints; it does not own the `Parser` state or grammar-driven consumption of those tokens.
